note: Fetch exact custom definitions from the target server (driver.mjs catalog get <ds> <Type...>). These host names are reserved, globally available in every design system and cannot be taken by a published component.

hostTypeNotes.Image: props.src — asset reference ({"$asset":"asset_<sha256>"}) or an absolute path starting with /
hostTypeNotes.Hotspot: clickable rectangle; requires screen.canvas, its rect is static numbers inside that canvas; forbidden inside repeat and inside a region subtree
hostTypeNotes.Overlay: viewport-sticky content (placement, optional inset and scrim); only as a direct child of the screen root; forbidden on desktop screens without canvas
hostTypeNotes.@eui/FlowRoot: neutral root required by region-based screens (region: statusBar|header|footer on its direct children); gives children nothing — no padding, color or font; allowed only in the root, without repeat/visible/on
hostTypeNotes.@eui/Composition: reference to a published composition (props.composition, props.params, props.variant); children are routed into the composition's slots; repeat and region on it are errors
hostTypeNotes.@eui/Slot: insertion point, valid only inside a composition document; inside a screen it is a validation error
